title: Top-k expert routing from one routing description (heterogeneous-expert-dispatch)
description: heterogeneous-expert-dispatch's Routing and its host reference: softmax or sigmoid scores before or after selection, a per-expert correction bias that only changes the selection, group limits, renormalization and scaling, ties to the lower expert id. The reference a device routing kernel is checked against; its device form runs the same rule over a step's router logits, through the registry kernel crit-labs/topk-routing (one launch, a warp per token row) where it loads and the rule has no group limit, in torch otherwise; capture-safe (no host synchronization; a captured round's or prompt chunk's junk rows of NaN logits still pick valid distinct experts, with weights 0: rounds:router, prompts:router).
